name: Purchase_Order
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (02 Procurement / 03 Purchase Order and Feasibility Gate, 05 Shared Engines 03, 04). One PO = one supplier = one mode (PO-R4); the lines carry their own Sales Order. Written by the server (server/modules/procurement/po-spec.mjs) except the deposit fields.

fields.name: Supplier_Id
fields.label: Supplier ID
fields.helpText: The Suppliers record ID. The name is only for display.

fields.name: Shipment_Mode
fields.label: Shipment Mode
fields.helpText: One PO = one mode: lines of another mode go on a separate PO.

fields.name: Earliest_Order_Date
fields.label: Earliest Customer Order Date
fields.helpText: The oldest Sales Order date among the lines (DT-1).

fields.name: Born_Late
fields.label: Born Late
fields.helpText: At least one line was raised although it cannot arrive in time (PO-R1, PO-R3).

fields.name: Shortfall_Days
fields.label: Shortfall (days)
fields.helpText: The largest shortfall among the lines, after the choice made at Create PO.

fields.name: Feasibility_Note
fields.label: Feasibility Note
fields.helpText: Per line: how many days late, and the option the buyer chose.

fields.name: Deposit_Paid
fields.label: Deposit Paid
fields.helpText: Restricted: buyer, supervisor, admin (PO-R7). The supplier ladder reads it.

fields.name: Lines_Raised
fields.label: Lines Raised
fields.helpText: How many lines this PO raised (spec PO-R3: the base of the born-late rate). Server-written.

fields.name: Lines_Born_Late
fields.label: Lines Born Late
fields.helpText: Lines that could not arrive in time AT THE GATE, before any option was chosen (spec PO-R3). Server-written.

fields.name: Po_Category
fields.label: Urgency
fields.helpText: The most urgent category of the PO's shipments (Sorting Engine). Server-written.

fields.name: Po_Queue_Rank
fields.label: Queue Rank
fields.helpText: Best rank of the PO's shipments. Server-written.

fields.name: Po_Forecast_Pickable
fields.label: Forecast Pickable
fields.helpText: Latest forecast pickable date of the PO's shipments. Server-written.
